title: When Feedback Beats an Exhaustive Open-Loop Frontier but Not Structured Control: Exact Benchmarking of Recurrent RL in a Supply-Chain DES
highlights: All 65,536 admissible open-loop calendars are evaluated.
RecurrentPPO robustly exceeds the complete open-loop frontier.
Structured control is practically equivalent to RecurrentPPO.
Worst-product service non-inferiority is not established.
The protocol separates feedback value from neural premium.
